title: Kubernetes

fields.name: buffer_size
fields.description: Set the buffer size for HTTP client when reading responses from Kubernetes API server.

fields.name: kube_url
fields.description: API Server end-point

fields.name: kube_ca_file
fields.description: CA certificate file

fields.name: kube_ca_path
fields.description: Absolute path to scan for certificate files

fields.name: kube_token_file
fields.description: Token file

fields.name: kube_tag_prefix
fields.description: When the source records comes from Tail input plugin, this option allows to specify what's the prefix used in Tail configuration.

fields.name: merge_log
fields.description: When enabled, it checks if the log field content is a JSON string map, if so, it append the map fields as part of the log structure.

fields.name: merge_log_key
fields.description: When Merge_Log is enabled, the filter tries to assume the log field from the incoming message is a JSON string message and make a structured representation of it at the same level of the log field in the map.

fields.name: merge_log_trim
fields.description: When Merge_Log is enabled, trim (remove possible \n or \r) field values.

fields.name: merge_parser
fields.description: Optional parser name to specify how to parse the data contained in the log key.

fields.name: keep_log
fields.description: When Keep_Log is disabled, the log field is removed from the incoming message once it has been successfully merged (Merge_Log must be enabled as well).

fields.name: tls.debug
fields.description: Debug level between 0 (nothing) and 4 (every detail).

fields.name: tls.verify
fields.description: When enabled, turns on certificate validation when connecting to the Kubernetes API server.

fields.name: tls.verify_hostname
fields.description: When enabled, turns on hostname validation for certificates

fields.name: use_journal
fields.description: When enabled, the filter reads logs coming in Journald format.

fields.name: cache_use_docker_id
fields.description: When enabled, metadata will be fetched from K8s when docker_id is changed.

fields.name: regex_parser
fields.description: Set an alternative Parser to process record Tag and extract pod_name, namespace_name, container_name and docker_id.

fields.name: k8s-logging.parser
fields.description: Allow Kubernetes Pods to suggest a pre-defined Parser (read more about it in Kubernetes Annotations section)

fields.name: k8s-logging.exclude
fields.description: Allow Kubernetes Pods to exclude their logs from the log processor (read more about it in Kubernetes Annotations section).

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Include Kubernetes pod resource labels in the extra metadata.

fields.name: annotations
fields.description: Include Kubernetes pod resource annotations in the extra metadata.

fields.name: kube_meta_preload_cache_dir
fields.description: If set, Kubernetes meta-data can be cached/pre-loaded from files in JSON format in this directory, named as namespace-pod.meta

fields.name: dummy_meta
fields.description: If set, use dummy-meta data (for test/dev purposes)

fields.name: dns_retries
fields.description: DNS lookup retries N times until the network start working

fields.name: dns_wait_time
fields.description: DNS lookup interval between network status checks

fields.name: use_kubelet
fields.description: this is an optional feature flag to get metadata information from kubelet instead of calling Kube Server API to enhance the log.

fields.name: use_tag_for_meta
fields.description: When enabled, Kubernetes metadata (e.g., pod_name, container_name, namespace_name etc) will be extracted from the tag itself.

fields.name: kubelet_port
fields.description: kubelet port using for HTTP request, this only works when Use_Kubelet set to On.

fields.name: kubelet_host
fields.description: kubelet host using for HTTP request, this only works when Use_Kubelet set to On.

fields.name: kube_meta_cache_ttl
fields.description: configurable TTL for K8s cached pod metadata.

fields.name: kube_token_ttl
fields.description: configurable 'time to live' for the K8s token.

fields.name: kube_token_command
fields.description: Command to get Kubernetes authorization token.

fields.name: kube_meta_namespace_cache_ttl
fields.description: configurable TTL for K8s cached namespace metadata.

fields.name: namespace_labels
fields.description: Include Kubernetes namespace resource labels in the extra metadata.

fields.name: namespace_annotations
fields.description: Include Kubernetes namespace resource annotations in the extra metadata.

fields.name: namespace_metadata_only
fields.description: Include Kubernetes namespace metadata only and no pod metadata.

fields.name: owner_references
fields.description: Include Kubernetes owner references in the extra metadata

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit Kubernetes Filter allows to enrich your log files with Kubernetes metadata.
